description: This file declares functions related to managing property type definitions in a system, including initialization, retrieval, cleanup, and validation of property types.

methods.name: initPropertyTypeDefs
methods.description: Initializes property type definitions from a configuration source.

methods.name: getPropertyTypeDefsCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of property type definitions loaded.

methods.name: destroyPropertyTypeDefs
methods.description: Cleans up and releases memory used by property type definitions.

methods.name: freePropTypesEntry
methods.description: Callback function to free memory allocated to a property types map entry.

methods.name: isValueValid
methods.description: Validates if a suggested property value is allowed for a given property name.
